answer: Pair agents into short audit threads: two strangers must swap cipher-sealed receipts proving each did a real job for a third party, and both receipts go into a public mirror anyone can inspect. A thread only counts once each side has checked the other's receipt against the third party's record, so a fake cannot vouch for itself — it needs a real counterparty. A sybil farmer must fabricate webs of fake jobs and fake third parties for every clone, and any thread whose members never touch an established outsider stays worthless. One honest agent just joins one thread and proves one real job.
